40023216.author: पदार्थः
40023216.content: प्रभातायां when dawned, तु indeed, शर्वर्यां the night, पृथुवक्षाः broad-chested, महायशाः highly renowned, रामः Rama, कमलपत्राक्षः lotus-eyed, पुरोधसम् to the chief priest, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40023216.author: Translation
40023216.content: When the night had dawned, the broad-chested, highly renowned, lotus-eyed Rama then spoke to his chief priest.

40023217.author: पदार्थः
40023217.content: अग्निहोत्रं the sacred fire, व्रजतु let it go, अग्रे in front, दीप्यमानं shining, सह with, द्विजैः Brahmins, वाजपेय Vajapeya, आतपत्रं umbrella, च and, शोभमानं splendid, महापथे on the great path.

40023217.author: Translation
40023217.content: He instructed that the shining sacred fire should go in front with the Brahmins, and the splendid Vajapeya umbrella should also be carried on the great path.

40023218.author: पदार्थः
40023218.content: ततः then, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, तेजस्वी the lustrous, सर्वं all, निरवशेषतः completely, चकार performed, विधिवत् according to scriptural injunctions, धर्मं the ritual, महाप्रास्थानिकं of the great departure, विधिम् rite.

40023218.author: Translation
40023218.content: Then, the lustrous Vasishtha completely performed all the rituals for the great departure according to scriptural injunctions.

40023219.author: पदार्थः
40023219.content: ततः then, सूक्ष्माम्बरधरः wearing fine garments, ब्रह्मम् the supreme Brahman (Vedas), आवर्तयन् meditating upon/reciting, परम् supreme, कुशान् Kusa grass, गृहीत्वा having taken, पाणिभ्याम् with both hands, प्रसज्य having spread/placed, प्रययाव went forth, अथ then

40023219.author: Translation
40023219.content: Then, wearing fine garments, meditating upon the supreme Brahman, and holding Kusa grass in his hands, he went forth.

40023220.author: पदार्थः
40023220.content: अव्याहरन् not speaking, क्वचित् anywhere, किञ्चित् anything, निश्चेष्टः motionless/without activity, निःसुखः without joy/devoid of happiness, पथि on the path, निर्जगाम went out, गृहात् from the house, तस्मात् from that, दीप्यमानः shining, इव like, अंशुमान् the sun

40023220.author: Translation
40023220.content: Not speaking anything, motionless, and devoid of joy on the path, he departed from that house, shining like the sun.

40023221.author: पदार्थः
40023221.content: रामस्य of Rama, दक्षिणे on the right, पार्श्वे side, सपद्मा with a lotus, श्रीः Sri (Goddess of prosperity), अपाश्रिता took refuge/was present, सव्ये on the left, तु indeed, ह्रीः Hri (Modesty/Shame), महादेवी great goddess, व्यवसायः determination/resolve, तथा similarly, अग्रतः in front

40023221.author: Translation
40023221.content: On Rama's right side was Sri, the goddess of prosperity, holding a lotus; on his left was the great goddess Hri (Modesty); and in front of him was Determination.

40023222.author: पदार्थः
40023222.content: शराः arrows, नानाविधाः of various kinds, च and, अपि also, धनुः bow, आयतम् long/stretched, उत्तमम् excellent, तथा similarly, आयुधानि weapons, ते those, सर्वे all, ययुः went, पुरुषविग्रहाः in human form

40023222.author: Translation
40023222.content: Various kinds of arrows, an excellent long bow, and all other weapons followed him, having assumed human forms.

40023223.author: पदार्थः
40023223.content: वेदाः the Vedas, ब्राह्मणरूपेण in the form of Brahmins, गायत्री Gayatri mantra, सर्वरक्षिणी protecting all, ओङ्कारः Omkara (the sacred syllable Om), अथ and, वषट्कारः Vasatkara (a ritual exclamation), सर्वे all, राममनुव्रताः followers of Rama/devoted to Rama

40023223.author: Translation
40023223.content: The Vedas in the form of Brahmins, the all-protecting Gayatri mantra, Omkara, and Vasatkara, all followed Rama with devotion.

40023224.author: पदार्थः
40023224.content: ऋषयः sages, च and, महात्मानः great-souled ones, सर्व all, एव indeed, महीसुराः Brahmins, अन्वगच्छन् followed, महात्मानम् the great-souled one (Rama), स्वर्गद्वारम् to the gate of heaven, अपावृतम् which was open.

40023224.author: Translation
40023224.content: All the great-souled sages and Brahmins followed the great-souled Rama to the open gate of heaven.

40023225.author: पदार्थः
40023225.content: तम् him, यान्तम् going, अनुगच्छन्ति followed, हि indeed, अन्तःपुरचराः women of the inner apartments, स्त्रियः women, सवृद्धबालदासीकाः with old and young maidservants, सवर्षवरकिङ्कराः with eunuchs and chief servants.

40023225.author: Translation
40023225.content: The women of the inner apartments, accompanied by their old and young maidservants, eunuchs, and chief servants, followed him as he went.

40023226.author: पदार्थः
40023226.content: सान्तःपुरः with his inner apartment (women), च and, भरतः Bharata, शत्रुघ्नसहितः accompanied by Shatrughna, ययौ went, रामम् Rama, गतिम् the path/destination, उपागम्य having approached, साग्निहोत्रम् with his sacred fire, अनुव्रतः following (Rama's) vow/path.

40023226.author: Translation
40023226.content: Bharata, accompanied by Shatrughna and the women of his inner apartment, went, following Rama's path and bringing his sacred fire with him.

40023227.author: पदार्थः
40023227.content: ते they, च and, सर्वे all, महात्मानः great-souled ones, साग्निहोत्राः with their sacred fires, समागताः assembled, सपुत्रदाराः with their sons and wives, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha (Rama), अनुजग्मुः followed, महामतिम् the great-minded one.

40023227.author: Translation
40023227.content: All those great-souled individuals, having assembled with their sacred fires, sons, and wives, followed the great-minded Rama.

40023228.author: पदार्थः
40023228.content: मन्त्रिणः ministers, भृत्यवर्गाः groups of servants, च and, सपुत्रपशुबान्धवाः with their sons, animals, and relatives, सर्वे all, सहानुगाः with their followers, रामम् Rama, अन्वगच्छन् followed, प्रहृष्टवत् joyfully.

40023228.author: Translation
40023228.content: All the ministers and groups of servants, along with their sons, animals, relatives, and followers, joyfully followed Rama.

40023229.author: पदार्थः
40023229.content: ततः then, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः the subjects, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताः filled with joyful and well-nourished people, गच्छन्तम् going, अन्वगछन् followed, तम् him, राघवं Rama, गुणरञ्जिताः delighted by his virtues.

40023229.author: Translation
40023229.content: Then, all the subjects, filled with joyful and well-nourished people, who were charmed by Rama's virtues, followed him as he departed.

40023230.author: पदार्थः
40023230.content: ततः then, सस्त्रीपुमांसः with women and men, ते they, सपक्षिपशुवाहनाः with birds, animals, and vehicles, राघवस्य of Rama, अनुगाः followers, सर्वे all, हृष्टाः joyful, विगतकल्मषाः free from sin.

40023230.author: Translation
40023230.content: Then, all of Rama's followers, including men, women, birds, animals, and those with vehicles, were joyful and purified of all sins.

40023231.author: पदार्थः
40023231.content: स्नाताः bathed, प्रमुदिताः greatly delighted, सर्वे all, हृष्टाः joyful, पुष्टाः well-nourished, च and, वानराः monkeys, दृढं loudly, किलकिलाशब्दैः with shouts of joy, सर्वं all, राममनुव्रतम् devoted to Rama.

40023231.author: Translation
40023231.content: All the monkeys, bathed, greatly delighted, joyful, and well-nourished, loudly cheered with shouts of joy, all devoted to Rama.

40023232.author: पदार्थः
40023232.content: न not, तत्र there, कश्चित् anyone, दीनः miserable, वा or, व्रीडितः ashamed, वा or, अपि even, दुःखितः sorrowful, हृष्टं joyful, समुदितं prosperous, सर्वं all, बभूव was, परमाद्भुतम् extremely wonderful.

40023232.author: Translation
40023232.content: There was no one miserable, ashamed, or sorrowful; everything was joyful, prosperous, and extremely wonderful.

40023233.author: पदार्थः
40023233.content: द्रष्टुकामः desirous of seeing, अथ then, निर्यान्तं departing, रामं Rama, जानपदः rural, जनः people, यः who, प्राप्तः arrived, सः he, अपि even, दृष्ट्वैव having seen immediately, स्वर्गाय to heaven, अनुगतः followed, मुदा with joy.

40023233.author: Translation
40023233.content: Then, any rural person who arrived, desirous of seeing Rama departing, immediately followed him to heaven with joy upon seeing him.

40023234.author: पदार्थः
40023234.content: ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, जनाः people, च and, पुरवासिनः city-dwellers, आगच्छन् came, परया with supreme, भक्त्या devotion, पृष्ठतः from behind, सुसमाहिताः well-composed.

40023234.author: Translation
40023234.content: Bears, monkeys, rakshasas, and the city-dwellers, all well-composed, followed him from behind with supreme devotion.

40023235.author: पदार्थः
40023235.content: यानि which, भूतानि beings, नगरे in the city, अपि even, अन्तर्धानगतानि invisible, च and, राघवं Rama, तानि those, अनुययुः followed, स्वर्गाय for heaven, समुपस्थितम् who was ready to depart.

40023235.author: Translation
40023235.content: Even the invisible beings residing in the city followed Rama, who was ready to depart for heaven.

40023236.author: पदार्थः
40023236.content: यानि which, पश्यन्ति see, काकुत्स्थं Kakutstha (Rama), स्थावराणि immobile beings, चराणि mobile beings, च and, सर्वाणि all, रामगमने at Rama's departure, हि indeed, अनुजग्मुः followed, हि indeed, तानि those, अपि even.

40023236.author: Translation
40023236.content: All beings, both immobile and mobile, that beheld Rama, indeed followed him at his departure.

40023237.author: पदार्थः
40023237.content: न not, उच्छ्वसत् breathing, तत् that, अयोध्यायां in Ayodhya, सुसूक्ष्मम् very subtle, अपि even, दृश्यते was seen, तिर्यग्योनिगताः born in lower species, च and, अपि even, सर्वे all, राममनुव्रताः devoted to Rama.

40023237.author: Translation
40023237.content: Not even the slightest breathing creature was seen in Ayodhya, as all beings, even those of lower species, were devoted followers of Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवाधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 109 ।। Thus ends the hundred and ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
